categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Adds script evaluation trace API functions and types to the libbitcoinkernel C API (`src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h`, `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp`) and its C++ wrapper (`src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h`).
categories.rationale: Adds an optional script evaluation tracer to the libbitcoinkernel API for downstream tooling. The PR enables external consumers to inspect intermediate execution state to build script debuggers and analyzers, and aids interpreter testing. While a clear addition to API capabilities, this is an optional build-time debugging and analysis tool rather than core library functionality for block validation or chainstate management.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: The PR's primary subject is the kernel library API, which the validation category definition explicitly excludes even when touching interpreter files, as it does not substantively alter consensus rules or validation behavior.
categories.rationale: Touches `src/script/interpreter.cpp` only to insert non-consensus trace hooks that compile away when disabled. Because the change does not alter validity rules, node acceptance, or consensus invariants, it falls under the kernel category rather than validation.
